newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent firmer as gas oil rises on tight physical.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent firmer as gas oil rises on tight physical.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures were firmer on Monday as gas oil futures were boosted sharply by a lack of physical product in the Rotterdam region, traders said.
August Brent crude was 16 cents a barrel firmer at $18.25 while August gas oil was $2.50 up at $164.50.
"Gas oil has performed very strongly because of tightness of physical material in Rotterdam and Brent has reluctantly followed it," one IPE broker said.
Dealers were also awaiting fresh news on the possibility of renewed Iraqi oil exports.

U.N. officials declined to comment on Monday about the outcome of a meeting in Baghdad between U.N. and Iraqi officials on Sunday, concerning the details of an aid distribution plan which could lead to fresh exports of Iraqi crude.
"In crude, the focus will be on developments in Iraq," GNI research said in a daily report.
Technical analysts were bullish in the short term but bearish in the medium term, with strong resistance to any price rises expected to be felt at $18.40-$18.50.
